info.title: MicroService API
info.description: Generated from the resource registry. Bearer API-key auth on all /api/v1/* except health. Success: `{data, meta}`. Errors: RFC 9457 problem+json. Every response carries X-Request-Id; rate limits via X-RateLimit-* / 429. Reads carry an ETag — pass it back as If-None-Match for a 304 Not Modified. Every GET endpoint also answers HEAD (same status/headers, no body).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opt into keyset pagination (stable, index-fast, ideal for n8n). Send the param empty to start, then follow meta.pagination.nextCursor until it is null. Iterates by id; combine only with sort=id / -id.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by one or more columns, comma-separated (e.g. -price,name); prefix "-" for descending. Allowed: sku, name, price, created_at (and id). Any other column is rejected with 400 (not silently ignored).

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated sparse fieldset. Allowed: id, sku, name, price, status, created_at, updated_at.

parameters.name: filter[sku]
parameters.description: Filter. Columns: sku, status, price. Operators: eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, in, nin (e.g. filter[col][gte]=10). Numeric columns require numeric values (a non-numeric value is rejected with 400, never coerced); for like, % and _ match literally.
